request.style: English, male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, fiddle, upright bass, gentle percussion, warm and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The family line of Noah's sons
Shem and Ham and Japheth born
After the flood the waters dried
And nations spread on every side

[Pre-Chorus]
Ham became the father there
Of Cush and Egypt and Put
Canaan joined them in the land
Where scattered peoples made a stand

[Chorus]
The sons of Cush came to be
Seba Havilah Sabtah too
Raamah and Sabteca named
In the book of Genesis famed

[Verse]
Sabteca is listed clear
One of the six who appear
In the genealogy found
Of the people on the ground

[Pre-Chorus]
He is the grandson of Ham
Great-grandson of Noah's name
A part of the line that grew
In the lands that the nations knew

[Chorus]
The sons of Cush came to be
Seba Havilah Sabtah too
Raamah and Sabteca named
In the book of Genesis famed

[Bridge]
1 Chronicles tells it again
Confirming his place in the plain
Of the Hamitic line that spread
To the lands that were never dead

[Outro]
From the flood to the nations known
Sabteca stands in the throne
